answers.question: How do I view the event history on this panel?
answers.text:
Manual extracts only — no language-model answer. These passages may help; they do not establish the complete answer.
1. “For this fictional panel, the read-only event history is available from the front controls. 1. Press VIEW on the panel front. 2. Select EVENT HISTORY from the displayed menu. 3. Use the UP and DOWN buttons to browse the stored events. 4. Press BACK to leave event history. The EVENT HISTORY menu is inside VIEW. Step two selects EVENT HISTORY after VIEW has already been opened. Viewing the log does not clear its entries or reset a fault. This”
2. “Manufacturer: Test Bench Model: FINDR-QA-100 Equipment: Fire alarm control panel Document type: User guide Revision: QA-027 This fictional fire alarm control panel exists only for browser verification. The model names, buttons and behaviour below do not describe real equipment. Confirm the equipment label before applying any actual manufacturer procedure. This fixture supports read-only questions about event history.”
